title: HB2334 (2026 Regular Session): Prohibits persons under eighteen years of age from carrying firearms into public areas within urban areas

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.010 (RSMo): "Urban area", any area of this state that is: (a) Within a metropolitan statistical area, as defined by the United States Office of Management and Budget, with a principal city of more than one hundred thousand inhabitants; and (b) Classified as an urban area by the United States Census Bureau.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Carries a firearm into any area accessible to the public within any urban area if the person is under eighteen years of age.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Subdivision (12) of subsection 1 of this section shall not apply if the firearm is otherwise lawfully possessed by a person: (a) In the course of employment. A person who is employed in a position described in subsection 2 of this section and who lawfully possesses the firearm in the course of that employment qualifies for this exemption from subdivision (12) of subsection 1 of this section regardless of any additional requirements for the exemption specified in subsection 2 of this section; (b) In the course of target practice or hunting; or (c) During instruction in the safe and lawful use of a firearm.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): Subdivision (12) of subsection 1 of this section shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor.
